Work out using short division. Provide your answer in the form "quotient r remainder" (e.g. 53 r 7):
\(523 \div 8\)
questions.hint: Divide 52 by 8 first. The leftover units at the end will be the remainder.

steps.explain: Divide 52 by 8.
Carry the remainder 4 to the units place to make 43. Divide 43 by 8.
State the quotient and the final remainder.

questions.stem: If 5460 dollars is to be divided equally among 6 people, how much will each person receive? (Do not include the dollar sign or the word dollars in your answer)

steps.explain: Set up the division to divide 5460 dollars equally among 6 people.
Divide 54 by 6 first, then divide 6 by 6, and finally the 0 units.
Combine the digits to find the final amount each person receives.

questions.stem:
There are 685 tennis balls to be packed into boxes of 12. How many boxes will be filled and how many tennis balls will be left over?
Provide your answer in the form "boxes, left over" (e.g. 57, 1).
questions.hint: Divide 685 by 12. The quotient is the number of boxes, and the remainder is the leftover balls.

steps.explain: Divide 685 by 12. Start by dividing 68 by 12.
Carry the remainder 8 to make 85. Divide 85 by 12.
The quotient 57 represents the filled boxes, and the remainder 1 represents the leftover tennis balls.

questions.stem:
Eggs are sold in cartons of 12. If there are 415 eggs to be packaged, how many full cartons will there be and how many eggs will be left over?
Provide your answer in the form "cartons, left over" (e.g. 34, 7).
questions.hint: Divide 415 by 12. The quotient is the number of cartons and the remainder is the leftover eggs.

steps.explain: Divide 415 by 12. First, divide 41 by 12.
Carry the remainder 5 to make 55. Divide 55 by 12.
State the quotient (full cartons) and remainder (leftover eggs).

questions.stem:
Cans of lemonade are to be packaged together in groups of 6. The factory has 5834 cans to be packaged. How many packages of 6 cans are there and how many are left over?
Provide your answer in the form "packages, left over" (e.g. 972, 2).
questions.hint: Divide 5834 by 6. The quotient represents the packages and the remainder represents the leftover cans.

steps.explain: Divide 5834 by 6. Start by dividing 58 by 6.
Carry the 4 to make 43. Divide 43 by 6.
Carry the 1 to make 14. Divide 14 by 6.
State the quotient (packages) and remainder (leftover cans).
